summary: My Bakery Empire Cake Maker! Become a cooking master chef in your own bake shop!
description:
Dear Coco Players, search no more, the opportunity to unlock 25+ of our games with only one subscription has found you!
This CrazyLabs Pass offers everything you’ve ever dreamed of:
No Ads
Everything unlocked
Shared on 10 of your devices
Unlimited fun
Endless joy
Become part of this CrazyLabs Pass  and enjoy it to the fullest!

Once upon a time, there was a wannabe baker who wanted to make some sweet escapes into the dream of becoming a cake maker! Enjoy this mouth-watering cake bakery story and help Lizzie fulfill her dream of someday opening up a sweet bakery of her own. Now that day has finally arrived! She's graduating from college, and she's more than ready to get baking some tasty cupcakes. But she needs your help to become a cooking fever master! Have fun opening up lots of delicious bakeries, baking with Lizzie and becoming a true baking professional who’s famous for beautiful, tasty delights! From bake shop to sweet escapes, My Bakery Empire lets you build your baker business. Immerse yourself in the aromatic wonders of a bustling bake shop with a hint of cookie jam sweetness.

Help Lizzie open up world-famous bakeries and take specific orders from her demanding customers! Learn how to bake delicious, mouth-watering desserts like cupcake, smoothies, donuts and cake! With your assistance as a cake maker, Lizzie will become the most talented pastry chef ever in her own kitchen! You’ll just LOVE this tasty bakery story game! 

But here’s a little warning - this bakery story game WILL make you hungry!

Features:
> You’ll love this fun cake shop story game! Help Lizzie open up a cake bakery… and then another cake bakery… and another cake bakery! There’s no such thing as too many bake shops! And definitely no such thing as too many cupcakes and cookie jam sweetness!
> Take specific orders from your customers, and serve them with a smile! Make sure they get exactly what they asked for, whether it’s cupcakes, donuts or rainbow cake!
> Learn how to bake tons of desserts from so many delicious recipes, with a professional cake maker and cooking master chef!
> Make your cakes extra fancy with colorful rainbow cake decorations!
> Dress up Lizzie like the true baker she is! Give her a pretty chef’s hat and a pretty apron like a real cake maker!
> Show off your sweet bakery skills and win first prize in baking contests and cake fairs!
> Get ready to bake the tastiest dessert ever, from apple yogurt smoothies to princess birthday cake, to scrumptiously delicious cupcake in your own bake shop!
> Build up your reputation and become the most famous baker in the world, in this fabulous sweet bakery simulator game!
> Cooking delicious dessert recipes in Lizzie’s kitchen has never been easier! Feel the cooking fever and help her bake the tastiest pastries ever! 
> Combine the excitement of a bake shop and the charm of sweet escapes in My Bakery Empire's immersive baker business simulation.
